verdicts.summary: The lifecycle hazards left open by this note are findings 0 (bare status:null settles a running compaction as stopped) and 1 (a boundary reuses a stale completed item). I checked the other settle and routing paths and they hold: finalizeActiveTurn settles a running item before clearing activeTurn, a new turn is refused while one is active, and status frames never route to a settled context. Refinement to finding 0: if a boundary follows the bare null, the boundary creates a second item with a new id (context.compaction is already null), so the user sees a 'stopped' row plus a separate 'compacted' row, not one stuck row.
verdicts.scenario: Status frame with activeTurn null or settled: parentToolUseId is null for system messages (2533-2537), so settledTurnForSubagentFrame returns null (6832-6833) and the frame is buffered, not attached to a finalized context. Turn end while compacting: finalizeActiveTurn (6055-6071) settles the item before activeTurn is cleared (6316). Attach while a turn is still active: refused (8757-8763), so an unsettled item cannot be orphaned by a new turn.

verdicts.summary: The /compact pending check is scoped to the whole run, not to the /compact. An earlier automatic compaction in the same run that ended interrupted, failed or cancelled now counts as settled, so a later /compact in that run shows no 'Compacting' state until its own running item arrives.
verdicts.scenario: Dependency: needs a /compact user message in the same run as an earlier automatic compaction. I did not read the steering path that would put it there. Steps: (1) Run R has an automatic compaction that ends interrupted, failed or cancelled, so its item is settled (ClaudeAdapterV2.ts:7157, 6061). (2) The user sends /compact in run R. (3) Before the SDK's compacting status creates a running item for this /compact, web sets compactRequestIsActive (ChatView.tsx:2508-2516) but compactionSettled is already true from step 1 (2517-2525), so isCompacting is false (2533-2535). Mobile finds the /compact message (use-thread-composer-state.ts:345-351), but the run-wide some() check (353-361) is already true, so isCompacting is false. (4) Once the running item arrives, both clients flip to compacting (ChatView 2526-2531, mobile 337-344).
verdicts.consequence: For the short window before the running item arrives, the 'Compacting' label is not shown and steering is not blocked for the manual /compact. The completed-only version had the same run-wide gap; this change widens it to failed, interrupted and cancelled.

verdicts.summary: If the SDK sends result before compact_boundary for an automatic compaction, the turn finalizer labels a successful compaction 'Context compaction failed', and the boundary then adds a second completed row. The finalizer marks a running item failed on a completed turn (6063-6064), and context.compaction is already cleared (6071), so the boundary creates a new item (7185).
verdicts.missing: The order in which the real SDK sends result and compact_boundary for automatic compaction. The checkout has no SDK type or source (no node_modules). The only recorded compaction fixtures are manual /compact runs, where the order is compacting, success, boundary, result. Checking the SDK emitter, or a recording of an automatic compaction that ends a turn, would settle it.
